question: The sides of a triangle are 39 cm, 62 cm, and 85 cm. What is the length of its altitude corresponding to the side with a length of 62 cm?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Semi-perimeter (s) = (39 + 62 + 85) ÷ 2 = 93 cm

Area = √[93 × (93 − 39) × (93 − 62) × (93 − 85)]

Area = √[93 × 54 × 31 × 8] = 1116 cm²

Altitude to 62 cm side = (2 × Area) ÷ Base = (2 × 1116) ÷ 62

Altitude = 1116 ÷ 31 = 36 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 36 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Sides a = 39 cm, b = 62 cm, c = 85 cm.

Formula Used: Area = √[s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c)]; Area = (1/2) × base × altitude

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e93fcbac94dd8d412a98d18f03fc313b6601ccfc13091df2da6d0c3ea8ff3ab.png] 

⇒ Semi-perimeter s = (39 + 62 + 85) ÷ 2 = 93 cm

⇒ Area = √[93 × (93 − 39) × (93 − 62) × (93 − 85)]

⇒ Area = √[93 × 54 × 31 × 8]

⇒ Area = √[(31 × 3) × (2 × 27) × 31 × (2 × 4)]

⇒ Area = √[31² × 3 × 2 × 3³ × 2 × 2²]

⇒ Area = √[31² × 3⁴ × 2⁴] = 31 × 9 × 4 = 1116 cm²

⇒ Area = (1/2) × base × altitude

⇒ 1116 = (1/2) × 62 × h

⇒ 1116 = 31 × h

⇒ h = 1116 ÷ 31 = 36 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 36 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Heron's Formula

Used to find the area of a triangle when all three sides are known: Area = √[s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c)], where s is the semi-perimeter.

Altitude and Area Relationship

For any triangle, the altitude (h) to a specific base (b) is given by h = (2 × Area) ÷ b.

Obtuse Triangle Altitude

In an obtuse-angled triangle, the altitudes to the sides containing the obtuse angle fall outside the triangle on the extensions of the bases.
